lines: +// Procedural music bed: 45s, 112 BPM, D major — pad, pluck arpeggio, soft kick/hat, transition sweeps
+const L = new Float32Array(N), R = new Float32Array(N);
+  const s = Math.floor(at * SR), e = Math.min(N, s + Math.floor(dur * SR));
+  for (let i = s; i < e; i++) {
+    const t = (i - s) / SR, v = fn(t, dur) * gain;
+const env = (t, a, d) => Math.min(1, t / a) * Math.exp(-t / d);
+// chords: D  Bm  G  A  (2 beats each, loop) — warm, optimistic launch feel
+  const at = b * BEAT, ch = chords[Math.floor(b / 2) % 4];
+  const energy = Math.min(1, at / 6) * (at > 42 ? Math.max(0, (45 - at) / 3) : 1);
+    for (const m of ch) add(at, BEAT * 2.2, (t, d) =>
+      (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * note(m) * t) + .4 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * note(m) * 2 * t)) *
+    add(at, BEAT * 1.8, t => Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * note(ch[0] - 12) * t) * env(t, .01, .9), .16 * energy); // bass root
+  // kick on every beat, hat offbeat
+  add(at + BEAT / 2, .05, t => rnd() * env(t, .001, .018), .10 * energy);
+  // pluck arpeggio, 8ths cycling chord tones + octave sparkle
+    add(at + s * BEAT / 2, .3, t => (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * note(m) * t) + .35 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * note(m) * 3 * t)) * env(t, .004, .11),
+// whoosh at each scene cut + send-moment swell + final chord
+for (const m of [50, 57, 62, 66, 69]) add(42.2, 2.8, (t, d) => Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * note(m) * t) * Math.min(1, t / .3) * Math.min(1, (d - t) / 1.2), .12);
+  const t = i / SR, fade = Math.min(1, t / .4) * Math.min(1, (DUR - t) / .8);
+  L[i] = Math.tanh(L[i] * 1.15) * .8 * fade; R[i] = Math.tanh(R[i] * 1.15) * .8 * fade;
